definition: I. שׁוּט verb go or rove about (Late Hebrew, Aramaic שׁוּט rove, row ( Jonah 1:13 ), swim ( Isa 25:11 ), stroke , besmear ; see also שׁוֺט ); — Qal go or rove about: Perfect 3 plural, absolute שָׁטוּ הָעָם Num 11:8 ( J ; gathering manna), so, with ב location, Imperfect 3 masculine plural וַיָּשֻׁטוּ 2Sam 24:8 , Imperative masculine singular שׁוּטנָֿא v 2Sam 24:2 , Infinitive construct שׁוּט Job 1:7 , שֻׁט Job 2:2 (both || הִתְהַלֵךְ ), perhaps also Gen 24:63 ( לָשׁוּט for לָשׁוּחַ , so ᵑ6 Thes 1322 compare Di Gunk Dr ); Jer 8:6 Du reads שָׁט for שָׁב . — Participle שָׁטִים see שׁוּט denominative below Po`l. go eagerly, quickly, to and fro: Imperfect 3 masculine singular יְשׁוֺטְטוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ Amos 8:12 (|| וְנָעוּ ); absolute יְשֹׁטְטוּ Dan 12:4 with ב location, Imperative masculine plural שׁוֺטְטוּ Jer 5:1 , Participle plural מְשׁוֺטְטִים Zech 4:10 , מְשֹׁטְטוֺת 2Chr 16:9 (both of ׳ עֵינֵי י ). Hithpo`lel Imperative feminine plural, ב location, הִתְשׁוֺטַטְנָת Jer 49:3 run to and fro.
